user.title: Connect to Claude
user.description: Enter your Anthropic API key to use Claude as a conversation agent in Home Assistant. Get your key at console.anthropic.com.

data_description.api_key: Your Anthropic API key (starts with sk-ant-)

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Anthropic — check your network

abort.already_configured: Claude is already configured with this API key

data_description.prompt: Instructions that guide Claude's behavior. Leave blank for the default assistant prompt.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Allow Claude to control your smart home devices and read their state.
data_description.recommended: Use claude-3-5-haiku-latest with recommended settings (fastest and most cost-efficient).
data_description.chat_model: Claude model ID. See console.anthropic.com for available models.
data_description.max_tokens: Maximum number of tokens Claude can return per response.
data_description.temperature: Creativity of responses (0 = focused, 1 = creative). Not used with extended thinking.
data_description.thinking_budget: Token budget for Claude's internal reasoning (0 to disable). Requires a thinking-capable model.

abort.entry_not_loaded: Cannot add a conversation agent while the integration is not loaded

error.thinking_budget_too_large: Thinking budget must be less than the maximum tokens limit
